repos_data.description: An ntfy MCP server for sending/fetching ntfy notifications to self-hosted or ANY ntfy.sh server from AI Agents 📤 (supports secure token auth & more - use with npx or docker!)

Let your AI agent call your phone and talk to you — MCP servers for live, interruptible voice calls + tiered alerts, using free self-hosted pieces (pjsua2 + whisper.cpp + Linphone). No paid telephony, no extra API key.
MCP server for ntfy: publish notifications, read cached messages, manage users and topic access
